head: iPadOS 27.3 beta: double-tap the top of a window to make it full screen
dek: The iPadOS 27.3 beta adds a setting that lets you double-tap the top of an app window to zoom it to full screen, and double-tap again to go back.
details: It's under Settings > Multitasking & Gestures when Windowed Apps is on, called Double-tap Top of Window to Zoom. A double-click with a trackpad works too. iPadOS 27.3 is in beta.
means: Resizing windows on an iPad gets easier without the small controls in the corner.
todo: When iPadOS 27.3 arrives, turn it on in Settings > Multitasking & Gestures.
